_about: Per-region season rows for the best-time grid on /essentials/best-time-to-visit, for countries whose guide describes regions that differ (owner, 2026-10-01: 'Vietnam by region'). Every month here must be stated by the guide's own 'Best time to visit' section: each region carries the exact sentences it rests on (quotes), and season-regions.test.mjs fails if a quote is no longer in the guide, so a rewritten guide cannot leave these rows standing on text that is gone. Partial months the guide words loosely ('late Sep', 'early May') are left unrated rather than guessed.

quotes: the south from November to February, the central coast from February to early May, and the north from late September to November and again in March and April
most of the country has a rainy season from May to September
Central Vietnam also has its own typhoon season from September to November
